verdict.rationale: Workflow Builder lets any user combine triggers and steps into no-code automations, including webhook triggers that start workflows from outside Slack and conditional branching. Developers can also build Slack-hosted workflows in TypeScript via the Deno SDK, or event-driven apps through the Events API (Slack calls you). AI-flavored background work appears in daily recaps and in routing requests to agents with results delivered back. Missing for 10: evidence of AI agents autonomously running scheduled or long-lived background tasks (beyond recaps and request routing), documentation of scheduled/time-based triggers, a fuller step set than Workflow Builder's 'limited set of steps', and independent or hands-on corroboration.
